text: # Incident Report: Data Speed Degradation During IPL Match **Document ID:** INC_C09_INC_2026_0158 **Category:** C09 — Data Services & Speed **Department:** Network **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-06-12 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Summary Localised congestion at 6 sites near a stadium during a high-footfall event caused sustained data speed drops. ## Detection Method First flagged by a spike in customer-reported tickets and self-care app status checks, then confirmed against NOC monitoring dashboards. ## Timeline Congestion alarms triggered at 19:05 IST; temporary capacity boost via portable COW (Cell on Wheels) deployed by 20:10; normal service resumed post-event. | Time | Event | Observation | Action | |---|---|---|---| | T+0 | Fault detected | Alarm/ticket volume triggers investigation | On-call engineer paged | | T+10m | Initial triage | Affected scope estimated | Field/remote team engaged as needed | | T+Xh | Interim mitigation | Partial service restored where possible | Status page updated | | T+Yh | Full restoration | Service confirmed normal | Incident closed, RCA initiated if required | ## Customer Impact Estimated customers affected and service categories impacted are recorded in the internal incident-management system (ref: INC-2026-0158). Customer-facing status was published under Network > Service Status for the outage duration. ## Initial Hypothesis The initial working theory pointed to the most probable cause based on alarm signatures and affected-scope pattern; this was confirmed or revised during investigation. ## Investigation The response team correlated alarm data, affected-site/customer patterns, and any recent change or third-party activity
title: Data Speed Degradation During IPL Match
